title: 第7章 命血换仙缘第8章 云雾山凝命血
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“我虽不是仙，但我离登天只差一步之遥……不……半步！”
“半仙啊？”
“你好像很失望？你可知那半步登天之境，已是无数天骄人杰穷尽一生的目标。
你未入灵途，望半仙如井底之蛙窥月。
即入灵途，见半仙如蜉蝣仰观青天。
遥想当年，吾之仙名，名动九天十地，无数圣灵、人皇，从四海之外朝拜而来，三步一叩首，只为见吾之真容。”
声音突然浩大，宛若滚滚天音，震荡这方黑暗天域，那深邃的黑暗，宛若大幕在翻涌，波澜壮阔，极尽雄浑之势。
“牛逼！”周元确实不是很懂，但是换个想法，这是超越九境的存在，便觉非常牛逼。
“……”黑暗骤然一静，虽然得到了由衷的夸赞，只是这句牛逼，让他觉着莫名的……嗯……掉价。
也是，这小子刚入灵途，什么都不懂，对着牛弹琴，得到的最高奖励，也不过牛逼。
“半仙前辈，是您给我改的命？”周元继续询问。
“你爷爷胆敢拿命魂豪赌，我也不能吝啬，怎么样，那娘们儿滋味不错吧？”声音突然多了几分戏谑。
果然，那场相遇是提前预见的。
这半仙，确实非凡啊。
只是……
周元疑惑：“命魂？豪赌？”
“你爷爷没跟你解释？也是，来不及了。不管怎么说，你小子能得到仙缘，修炼仙法，我也算对得起他。”声音答应过那老头，便没再多说。
“半仙前辈，我该如何称呼您？”
“当年世人尊我盗祖……咳咳……讲道理的道，大道争锋的道……但那都是曾经了，如今的我已看透红尘，不在意那些虚名。既然与你相遇，便是缘，你就喊我声祖宗吧。”声音很随性，无所谓的点了个称呼。
祖宗？

周元的脸顿时一黑，这称呼也不怕折了你的寿。但有求于人，只能忍了：“您是跟我爷爷结的缘，又承到了我这里，我便称您声二爷爷吧。”
二爷爷？
这下轮到黑暗里的存在脸黑了。
怎么着，你爷爷还是我老大呗。
他一个打猎捡柴的，担得起吗。
“二爷，您说帮我，怎么帮？”周元真诚的请教。
“……”
黑暗里的存在盯着周元，刚刚还二爷爷，这回变二爷了。
省了一个字，掉了一整辈。
这小子是无心的，还是故意的？
也嗯啊的是个腹黑货？
content_en:
"Although I am not an immortal, I am only one step away from reaching heaven... no... half a step!"
"Half-immortal?"
"You seem disappointed? Do you know that reaching the halfway point of reaching heaven has been the goal of countless talented people who have spent their entire lives?
Before you enter the spiritual path, looking at the semi-immortal is like a frog at the bottom of a well peering at the moon.
When he entered the spiritual path, he saw a half-immortal looking up at the blue sky like a mayfly.
I recall that back then, my immortal name was famous throughout the nine heavens and ten earths. Countless holy spirits and human emperors came from all over the world to worship me, kowtowing every step of the way, just to see my true face. "
The sound was suddenly loud, like a roaring sound from the sky, shaking the dark sky. The deep darkness was like a surging curtain, magnificent and powerful.
"Awesome!" Zhou Yuan really didn't understand it very well, but when he thought about it, he thought that this was an existence that transcended the Nine Realms, and he felt that it was very awesome.
"..." Darkness suddenly fell silent. Although he received heartfelt praise, it was just this awesome sentence that made him feel inexplicably... well... worthless.
Also, this kid has just entered the spiritual path and knows nothing. Playing the piano to a cow, the highest reward he can get is nothing but awesomeness.
"Senior Half-Immortal, was it you who changed my life?" Zhou Yuan continued to ask.
"Your grandpa dares to gamble his life and soul, and I can't be stingy. How about that, does that bitch taste good?" The voice suddenly became a little more playful.
Sure enough, that encounter was foreseen in advance.
This half-immortal is indeed extraordinary.
Just...
Zhou Yuan was confused: "Life soul? A big gamble?"
"Your grandfather didn't explain it to you? That's right, it's too late. Anyway, if your boy can get the fate of immortality and practice immortality, I can be considered worthy of him." The voice promised the old man, and said no more.
"Senior Half Immortal, how should I call you?"
"Back then, the world respected me as the Thief Ancestor... ahem... for the way of truth, for the way of fighting... But that's all in the past. Now I have seen through the mortal world and don't care about those false names. Since meeting you is fate, just call me ancestor." The voice was very casual, and he nodded indifferently.
Ancestor?
Zhou Yuan's face suddenly darkened. This title is not afraid of shortening your life. But I have to ask for help from others, so I can only endure it: "You are destined to my grandfather, and you have inherited it from me, so I will call you second grandfather."
Second grandfather?
This time it was the being in the darkness' turn to look dark.
No matter what, your grandfather is still my boss.
Can he, a hunter and gather firewood, afford this?
"Second Master, you said you would help me, how can you help me?" Zhou Yuan asked sincerely.
"..."
The being in the darkness stared at Zhou Yuan. He had just returned to the second grandfather, but this time he became the second grandfather.
If you omit a word, you will lose a whole generation.
Did this kid do it unintentionally or on purpose?
Is he a shady guy?
